AOE Damage is damage dealt to both the targeted enemies and any additional enemies, with the number being based on the
max hits. The damage is the same as the melee attack's damage.
DPS is calculated as (Damage + AOE Damage) ÷ Swingrate. DPS does not include bleed damage.
Max DPS is calculated as (Damage + AOE Damage x Max Hits) ÷ Swingrate. Max DPS does not include bleed damage.
